purpose: P1 consistency fixture for the dsh-native Zig harness: drive initialize/newSession/seedFile/prompt, replay one read tool call, and compare the normalized v4 session log. It pins the assistant tool-call surface, the tool/call -> tool/result pair, the model-facing read rendering, and the next-step continuation.

recording.method: Recorded with dsh headless against a scripted Anthropic Messages SSE server. No real model, network, or credentials: DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL points at a loopback mock and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is the neutral placeholder test-key.
recording.command:
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh -v <dsh-record>:/work -e DSH_HOME=/tmp/dshhome -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=test-key -e DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18082 -e MOCK_MODE=tool-turn junclaw:full-dsh-test -c 'mkdir -p /work/ws4 /tmp/dshhome; printf "line one
line two
line three
" > /work/ws4/notes.txt; cd /work/ws4; node /work/mock-anthropic.mjs & sleep 0.5; /opt/dsh/node_modules/.bin/dsh --profile headless --patch /work/record.patch.yml "Read notes.txt with the read tool, then reply TOOL_TURN_DONE."'
recording.result: exit 0; stdout TOOL_TURN_DONE; one session.v4.jsonl with 21 physical rows (header + 20 events)
recording.profilePatch: <dsh-record>/record.patch.yml disables non-core tool plugins, keeps tool-fs read+write only, disables plan mode and the DeepSeek delivery log, and sets agent-default-model to provider deepseek-official/model fake.
recording.normalizationScript: <dsh-record>/generate-fixtures.mjs (scratch artifact; deterministic transform from the raw log to expected.v4.jsonl and replay.json)

v4GroundTruth.note: Real dsh v4 single-tool turn. Pins the session-start metadata, inbox splice/claim, system and user messages, request/header, assistant/message with a tool-call block, tool/call, tool/result, step/end, the next step, and turn/end.
Real dsh v4 parallel read turn. Pins the two-tool-call-before-two-results order and the exact read result envelope and meta.
Real dsh v4 mixed parallel/exclusive batches. Step 1 read (parallel) then bash (exclusive); step 2 four exclusive mutations. Pins model-order call/result commit.

replayHelper.note: deriveReplayScript rebuilds one model call per assistant/message from the compact stream; replay.json uses the same compact record shape.

scheduler.note: Exclusive calls form a barrier; parallel calls use a bounded rolling pool; policy/results/context commit in model order; tool/call is appended at start and tool/result cites its seq.

toolExecutionMode.note: A tool with no isConcurrencySafe classifier is exclusive; read declares isConcurrencySafe true, write does not.

deepseekTranslate.note: Usage totalTokens = input + output + cache; finish carries the provider replayState envelope.

inputContract.workspace: newSession.workspace creates notes.txt with three lines: line one, line two, line three. This is fixture-driver setup, not a session event.
inputContract.prompt: Read notes.txt with the read tool, then reply TOOL_TURN_DONE.

dshToFixtureDifferences.change: The recording is a real v4 log with the physical seq/time envelope and real UUID identities. The fixture drops the envelope, zeroes clocks, tokenizes identity/cwd, strips provider-only replayState and adapter-default header fields, and excludes the runtime-context user message.

One read call in step 1, its result committed in model order, then step 2 with a text-only assistant message and turn/end. The read result is the exact dsh rendering, including the End-of-file footer.

rules.rule: Drop seq/time from every event and zero createdAt and every assistant-stream clock. expected.v4.jsonl has no physical envelope.
rules.note: No wall-clock assertion is possible: every time value in the fixture is 0.

rules.rule: Replace the session id with {{session:1}}, each message id with {{message:N}} in first-appearance order, and the recorded cwd with {{cwd}}.
rules.note: Excluded runtime-context ids do not consume an ordinal, so the assistant/tool/next-step ids are dense 3,4,5.

rules.rule: Rewrite the recorded provider deepseek-official to fake in request/context and assistant source, and mask request/header config provider/model as {{provider}}/{{model}}. The model id was recorded as fake.
rules.note: Symmetric on both sides; the system prompt's literal fake model name is preserved.

rules.rule: Keep the recorded system message text verbatim; only its id and source are tokenized/normalized.
rules.note: The text is the ground truth for this recording: base identity, headless persona with model fake, read guidance, write guidance.

rules.rule: Keep request/header.tools as the exact recorded schema array in registration order read, write. Do not replace it with the {{tools}} token and do not drop descriptions, parameters, required lists, or the write sandbox escalation fields.
rules.note: This is the comparison focus: a schema drift changes the request header line.

rules.rule: Keep tool/result message content text verbatim except for the cwd token. This includes the <path>/<type>/<content> envelope, line numbers, blank line before the footer, and the exact footer.
rules.note: The read footer here is (End of file - total 3 lines).

rules.rule: Keep tool/result meta verbatim except for the cwd token: read offset/lines/totalLines and write operation/path/diffs.
rules.note: meta is persisted presentation data, not model-facing content; it is still compared.

rules.rule: Keep assistant/message.data.usage and the stream usage chunk exactly as replayed. totalTokens is input + output + cache.
rules.note: The replay provider returns the recorded usage chunk; the driver writes the matching usage object.

rules.rule: Remove the provider-specific replayState envelope from assistant source and from the terminal finish chunk. replay.json carries only portable stream records.
rules.note: replayState names the DeepSeek Messages adapter; the native harness has no such adapter.

rules.rule: Reduce request/header.header.config to provider and model. Drop adapterDefaults, maxTokens, and reasoningEffort, which the DeepSeek adapter materialized rather than the caller proposing them.
rules.note: The tool schemas inside the same header are untouched.

rules.rule: Reduce request/context to provider fake and model fake. Drop the recorded contextWindow adapter metadata.
rules.note: The native harness has no provider context-window advertisement in this fixture.

rules.rule: Exclude the recorded runtime-context user/message from expected.v4.jsonl. It is SDK-composed context, not part of the tool-turn contract; the plain-turn fixture excludes the same event.
rules.note: All excluded raw events are listed in excludedV4Events.

rules.rule: After excluding the runtime-context event, renumber tool/result.sourceEventSeqs to the zero-based index of the referenced tool/call in the normalized event list. tool-turn: [12].
rules.note: The catalog validation in validation.commands restores dense seqs and accepts [12] as the tool/call row.

rules.rule: Keep surfaceOp append on system/message, user/message, assistant/message, and tool/result. Keep it absent on log-only events.
rules.note: No replace op occurs in this turn.

rules.rule: replay.json calls[1..N].stream is the corresponding assistant/message.data.stream with time/time0/dt zeroed and replayState stripped. Calls are numbered 1..N and each stream is non-empty.
rules.note: The Zig ReplayProvider returns the stream verbatim; the driver writes it into assistant/message.data.stream.

replay.call1: tool-call stream: read notes.txt; finish reason tool-calls
replay.call2: text stream: TOOL_TURN_DONE; finish reason stop
replay.provider: ReplayProvider returns each stream verbatim, including block-start, compact chunks, block-end, usage, and finish.

excludedV4Events.reason: SDK-composed runtime context; excluded like plain-turn. It is the only excluded event in this recording.

openIssues: The recording used the published dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 install in junclaw:full-dsh-test, not a source build. The source tree at /root/jsplug-proto/dsh is the same version and supplies every cited line.

The fixture keeps the recorded system prompt text and tool schemas verbatim. If the native harness composes a different system prompt or tool schema order, this fixture fails by design; that is the consistency target, not a normalization gap.

The write tool schema includes sandbox_permissions/justification because the recording composes the sandbox tool suite. The native harness must expose the same fields under the default workspace-write preset.

validation.groundTruth: The raw recording is a valid v4 artifact under dsh's own session format catalog: 21 rows, 20 events, all types in known-event-types.ts.
commands: node validate-session.mjs raw/tool-turn.raw.v4.jsonl -> version 4, rows 21, events 20
node validate-session.mjs out/tool-turn/expected.v4.jsonl --tokens -> version 4, rows 20, events 19 (tokens materialized, dense seq/time restored)
node validate-replay.mjs out/tool-turn/replay.json -> call 1 tool-call/read/tool-calls, call 2 text/stop
bun -e 'JSON.parse(...)' self-check: every JSONL line parses; event type sequence matches expected; sourceEventSeqs [12] points at the tool/call row
